name: The Fencing & Boxing Studio
body: Clean lines, padded floors, mirrored walls. Punching bags from reinforced ceiling mounts, fencing lanes striping the floor, wall-mounted weapon racks. This room echoes with footwork and controlled breathing — Gwen shadowboxing at 2 AM, Livi's heavy-bag sessions after a long day, and the occasional sparring match that draws a small audience of girls pretending they came downstairs for water.
